in_hebrew.name: גַתְאַר
in_hebrew.long_meaning: The name Gathard is derived from the Hebrew word 'gathar', which means 'mountain of strength'. This name would have been a fitting one for a warrior or strong leader in ancient Israel.

in_greek.name: Γαθάρδος
in_greek.long_meaning: The name Gathard in Greek is Γαθάρδος, which translates to 'strong mountain'. This name was likely given to a person who was seen as a strong and powerful leader.

in_latin.name: Gathardus
in_latin.long_meaning: The Latin form of the name Gathard is 'Gathardus'. This name, derived from the Greek Γαθάρδος, carries the same meaning as the Hebrew and Greek forms: 'strong mountain'.
